## Sign-off

- [ ] Every commit in this pull request carries a `Signed-off-by` trailer naming its own author.

Sign a commit with `git commit -s`. An existing branch takes the trailer from
`git rebase --signoff <base>` followed by a push. The certificate being signed
is the Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1, kept verbatim in the `DCO` file at
the repository root and explained in `docs/en/contributing.md`.
